name: Causal Mediation Analysis of Environmental Mixtures
description: Code for a causal mediation benchmark of environmental chemical mixtures: BKMR-CMA, BART-CMA, and DeepMed compared across 12 synthetic scenarios, 2 NHANES-based plasmode cells, and an applied NHANES analysis of a metal/PFAS mixture, dietary inflammation, and liver outcomes. SLURM pipeline for Longleaf.
